subject: The branch is VETO, the swagger is Mr. Veto's
alt: Satish Acharya's cartoon: on the left a huge brown cliff juts out into the air, with the broken stub of a branch at its tip. On the right, against a white background, a man with golden hair in a dark blue suit hangs from a thin branch with both fists. The branch has two green leaves and above it is written: VETO. The man's eyes are shut in a smile, his red tie flies upward and his knees are bent. Vertical falling lines run on both sides of him and two puffs of dust rise below. Bottom left, in a round speech bubble: I'M MR. VETO! Bottom right, the cartoonist's signature: SATISH ACHARYA.
chutki: A branch has snapped off the edge of the cliff, and a man is falling with it, clutching it in both fists. The branch is labelled: VETO. In suit and tie, eyes shut in a smile, he announces: I'M MR. VETO! Falling lines run on both sides and puffs of dust rise below.

In the United States the veto is the president's power to send back a bill passed by Congress, and overriding it takes a two-thirds majority in both houses. Satish Acharya turns that last support into a branch: so thin it cannot take the whole weight, yet the man holding it smiles and gives his new name. Making a title of the twig in your hand even as you fall: that is the joke.
